rows.name: The Fool
rows.imagery: a green-clad, horned youth, wild and laughing, a crocodile beneath his feet and a dove above his head
rows.figure: the horned youth in green, laughing, a wand in one hand and a flaming cone in the other

rows.name: The Magus
rows.imagery: a winged youth juggling the instruments of magick, wand, cup, sword and disk, about a shining caduceus
rows.figure: the winged Magus, quick-eyed and bright, the caduceus shining in his hand

rows.name: The Priestess
rows.imagery: a veiled priestess of moonlight, a bow across her knees, a curtain of silver light falling around her
rows.figure: the veiled Priestess, crowned with silver, a bow resting across her knees

rows.name: The Empress
rows.imagery: a crowned queen enthroned among green and blue flames, a pelican feeding its young at her feet
rows.figure: the crowned Empress, calm and fruitful, a lotus sceptre in her hand

rows.name: The Emperor
rows.imagery: a crowned king in flame-red seated on a throne of rams, a sceptre topped with a ram's head in his hand
rows.figure: the crowned Emperor in flame-red, a ram-headed sceptre in his hand

rows.name: The Hierophant
rows.imagery: an ancient teacher enthroned upon a bull, a child dancing in the star at his heart, a woman with a sword before him
rows.figure: the Hierophant, an ancient teacher seated upon a bull, his hand raised in blessing

rows.name: The Lovers
rows.imagery: a hooded figure blessing a royal marriage of a dark king and a pale queen, twin children at their feet
rows.figure: a hooded priest with his arms stretched wide in blessing

rows.name: The Chariot
rows.imagery: an armoured charioteer sitting still as a statue, holding the Grail, his chariot drawn by four sphinxes
rows.figure: the armoured Charioteer, motionless, holding the Grail before him

rows.name: Adjustment
rows.imagery: a masked woman balanced on the point of a sword, holding a pair of scales in perfect equilibrium
rows.figure: the masked woman of Adjustment, poised on the point of her sword, her scales held level

rows.name: The Hermit
rows.imagery: an old man in a cloak bearing a lamp in which a small sun burns, a three-headed dog at his heel
rows.figure: the cloaked Hermit, his lamp held low, a small sun burning inside it

rows.name: Fortune
rows.imagery: a great ten-spoked wheel turning among stars and lightning, a sphinx, a monkey and a crocodile upon its rim
rows.figure: the Sphinx at the top of the turning wheel, a sword resting in its paws

rows.name: Lust
rows.imagery: a woman riding a lion-headed beast, her arm raised high with a cup of fire
rows.figure: the woman astride the lion-beast, her cup of fire held high

rows.name: The Hanged Man
rows.imagery: a man hanging upside down from an ankh, arms outstretched, green serpents coiled in the water below
rows.figure: the Hanged Man, still and serene, suspended head downward from the ankh

rows.name: Death
rows.imagery: a black-crowned skeleton sweeping a scythe, new forms rising in the bubbles it stirs, a scorpion and an eagle nearby
rows.figure: the black-crowned skeleton, leaning on the handle of his scythe

rows.name: Art
rows.imagery: a two-faced figure, dark and light, pouring fire into water over a cauldron, a rainbow arching overhead
rows.figure: the two-faced figure of Art, tending the cauldron where fire meets water

rows.name: The Devil
rows.imagery: a laughing goat with spiralling horns standing before a vast column rooted deep in the earth
rows.figure: the laughing goat with spiralling horns, his eye bright with mirth

rows.name: The Tower
rows.imagery: a tower shattered by fire streaming from a great eye, figures falling, a dove and a serpent in the sky
rows.figure: a Martial warrior in red, standing beneath the open Eye of Horus

rows.name: The Star
rows.imagery: a naked star-goddess pouring water from a golden cup and a silver cup beneath a great seven-pointed star
rows.figure: the star-goddess kneeling at the water's edge, a cup in each hand

rows.name: The Moon
rows.imagery: a path running between two dark towers beneath a waning moon, jackals at the gate, a scarab rising from the water
rows.figure: jackal-headed Anubis, standing at the gate between the two towers

rows.name: The Sun
rows.imagery: a great sun blazing over a green mound ringed by a wall, two winged children dancing in its light
rows.figure: the twin winged children, dancing hand in hand in the light

rows.name: The Aeon
rows.imagery: the star-bodied goddess arched over the sky, a globe of fire, and a child-god rising in the midst
rows.figure: the child Horus, rising in the midst of the fire, one finger at his lips

rows.name: The Universe
rows.imagery: a dancing woman within an ellipse of stars, a great serpent coiling about her, the four Kerubim at the corners
rows.figure: the dancing maiden, a great serpent coiled about her
